mapper.select: SELECT A.ACM_ID acm_id, A.ACM_NAME acm_name, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS detail_address, A.MAIN_IMG main_img, A.ACM_TYPE_ID acm_type_id, MIN(R.PRICE) AS price, MIN(R.DISCOUNT_PRICE) AS discountPrice FROM ACCOMMODATION A JOIN ROOM R ON A.ACM_ID = R.ACM_ID WHERE A.ACM_TYPE_ID = #{ACM_TYPE_ID} GROUP BY A.ACM_ID, A.ACM_NAME, A.DETAIL_ADDRESS, A.MAIN_IMG, A.ACM_TYPE_ID
SELECT A.ACM_ID ACM_ID, AVG(R.RATING) AS RATING, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEWCNT FROM ACCOMMODATION A LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON A.ACM_ID = R.ACM_ID WHERE A.ACM_ID = #{ACM_ID} GROUP BY A.ACM_ID
SELECT f.FCL_ID, f.FCL_NAME FROM FACILITIES f JOIN PROVIDED_FACILITIES pf ON f.FCL_ID = pf.FCL_ID WHERE pf.ACM_ID = #{acmId}
